name: Eurydice
subtitle: Ethereal Muse
description: Disruptor who lowers divinity and tandems with Orpheus.
lore: Of all the shades in Hades’ realm, few have as much cause to hate him as Eurydice. When her husband Orpheus charmed his way into the underworld to retrieve her, she was permitted to go—then yanked back at the last moment. Eurydice now seeks any opportunity for vengeance against Hades and Persephone, though so far none has presented itself.
